# Douglas Ferreira — Software, Society & Digital Culture

Sociologist and programmer. I write (mostly) about how algorithms shape politics, culture, and daily life.

Canonical site: https://douglasferreira.me/
Primary language: en

- Photos: https://douglasferreira.me/photos/ — A visual notebook of photos and captions.
- Readings: https://douglasferreira.me/books/ — Books I am reading and have read.
- Writings: https://douglasferreira.me/blog/ — Longer essays and posts.
